title: MenuCatalogQuarantinedV1
description: Owner-facing alert (spec 11 §8, Inv-14) emitted on the menu.commands lane when the malware scan flags an uploaded catalog artifact. The artifact is never extracted or published; this event surfaces the quarantine to the owner so a failed ingestion is never silently dropped. Carries NO secrets, PAN, artifact bytes, or transcript text (Inv-12) — only the catalog id and a coarse reason.

message_type.description: Explicit schema discriminator; always 'menu.catalog.quarantined.v1' for this contract.

correlation_id.description: Correlation identifier propagated across the ingestion chain (the catalog id).

causation_id.description: message_id of the ingestion message that caused this alert (nullable).

catalog_id.description: Stable id of the quarantined vendor_catalogs row.

reason.description: Coarse machine reason for the quarantine, e.g. 'malware_detected'. Never raw scanner output.
